auth_phone_hint: Only used for settling up after a game. We never send you an SMS.
auth_invite_hint: You need an invite code to create an account.
auth_avatar_hint: The image is cropped to a square and shrunk before uploading.
error_invalid_username: Username must be 3–20 characters, using only letters, numbers, _ and -.
error_invalid_phone: Invalid phone number. Enter eight digits, for example 90 00 00 00.
error_invalid_password: Password must be at least 8 characters.
error_invalid_invite: That invite code is invalid or has already been used.
error_phone_taken: That phone number is already registered.
error_invalid_avatar: The image must be JPEG, PNG or WebP, and under 512 kB.
home_tagline: Poker with your friends, wherever you are.
lobby_no_games: No games right now. Start one!
game_boks_hint: Create a Boks in the Vipps app and paste the code or link here. We can't see the balance — the Boks is only used to pay in and out.
game_buy_in_hint: One chip is one krone, so this is also the starting stack. The blinds are in kroner too.
game_voice_hint: A Discord invite, for example. We don't host voice in the browser.
error_invalid_game_name: The game needs a name of up to 60 characters.
error_invalid_blinds: Blinds must be whole numbers, and the small blind can't exceed the big blind.
error_invalid_stack: The starting stack must be at least ten big blinds.
error_invalid_seats: There must be between 2 and 9 seats.
error_invalid_turn_seconds: Time to act must be between 10 and 120 seconds.
error_missing_boks_code: You need a Vipps Boks code when playing for money.
error_invalid_buy_in: The buy-in must be a whole number of kroner.
error_buy_in_too_small: The buy-in must be at least ten big blinds.
error_invalid_voice_url: The link must be a valid https address.
error_game_not_found: No game found with that code.
table_waiting_for_host: Waiting for the host to start.
table_need_two: You need at least two players to start.
table_share: Share the code {code} with the others.
table_buy_in_title: How much are you buying in for?
error_already_at_max: You already have the maximum number of chips.
table_cash_out_pending: You cash out when this hand is over.
settle_fee_hint: Vipps keeps 19 kr for every whole 1000 kr held in the Boks. The fee is shared across what each person takes out.
settle_withdraw_hint: Everyone withdraws their own amount from the Boks in the Vipps app.
settle_pending: Amounts are final once the host ends the session.
settle_play_money: This game was played without money, so there is nothing to settle.
settle_not_ended: The game is still going. The settlement is final once the host ends the session.
error_not_host: Only the host can do that.
error_hand_in_progress: Wait until the hand is finished.
error_wait_for_next_hand: You'll have to wait until the next hand.
error_not_playing: You're not seated at this table.
error_need_two_players: You need at least two players to start.
replay_hidden_cards: Folded cards are only revealed once the session has ended.
error_not_your_game: You weren't part of this game.
